transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Hi, doctor. Thank you so much for seeing me. Um, I hope I'm not wasting your time, it's probably just a little stress or something, but... well, I guess what really brought me in is that my mind just won’t stay on one thing anymore. 

I'm a jeweler, and lately when I'm at the bench, I just... I jump around a lot. Like, I'll go from reading a customer email, to fixating on a saw mark on a piece of metal, to just getting caught up in some random noise outside. And then I realize I’ve completely lost track of the whole work order. It's a little embarrassing to admit, honestly, because I always try to be really dependable. Is that... does that make sense to come in for?
Did this trouble with your mind jumping around start suddenly or did it come on gradually over time?

Um, well... I think it was actually pretty sudden. I hope it doesn't sound silly, but I recently won an award at this big jewelry show. Which was amazing, I was really grateful for it. But right after that, I just... I got really wired. 

I thought I was just excited, you know? But it turned into this whole stretch where I felt a little, um, out of control, I guess? Like my engine was just revving way too high and I couldn't turn it down. And that went on for about two weeks. I mean, it's probably normal to get a little overly worked up after a big win, right? I just didn't expect it to last quite that long. Does that sound like a normal reaction to you?
Have you been feeling restless or fidgety, like you can't sit still?

Well... yeah, maybe a little bit. I mean, I hope it just means I was really dedicated to my work, right? But... I guess during that time, I really couldn't just sit still at my bench. 

I'd, um... I'd start sketching out a new watch case, and then a minute later I'm bouncing up to email suppliers, and then I'm out front rearranging all the display trays... and I'd be doing all this long after closing time. I just really wanted to keep the momentum going, you know? I was just trying to be super productive. I hope that doesn't make me sound too scattered or irresponsible. Does that sound like it could just be... normal extra energy to you?
Are you finding it harder to get your work done or meet your responsibilities because of these symptoms?

Um, well... I guess, honestly, it has been a little tough. I mean, I really try to stay on top of things, I promise I do. But, um... I actually missed a major custom delivery recently. I know, it's terrible, I felt so bad about it. And my shop records just got so... disorganized during that whole stretch that I actually had to stop taking new work for right now. Just until I get caught up, you know? 

And, um, my family has been checking in on me a bit more, too. I guess they just got a little worried because I wasn't really keeping up with my usual routines. I hope that doesn't make it sound like I'm completely falling apart. I'm really trying to get back on track. Do you think it's okay that I took a little step back from taking new orders just to catch my breath?
How much distress or upset have these changes been causing you?

Um, well... I mean, I try not to let things get to me too much. I want to be someone who just handles whatever comes up, you know? But... I guess it has been a little upsetting. 

Just because I usually pride myself on being so reliable with my work and, um, seeing my shop get so messy and letting down that client... it did make me feel pretty bad. I just don't want people to think I'm slacking off or that I don't care. I really do care. I mean, it's normal to feel a little stressed when you fall behind, right? I'm just hoping this is all just a temporary bump in the road. Does that sound reasonable to you?
Have these changes affected your relationships with family or friends?

Um, well... I mean, I think things are mostly okay. I really try to be a good friend and, you know, a good son. I don't want to cause any trouble for anyone. 

I guess... like I said, my family has been checking in a bit more, which is nice of them. Maybe I haven't been as available to hang out with my friends lately, just because I was so focused on the shop and then trying to fix the mess in the shop. But nobody's, like, mad at me or anything. At least, I really hope they aren't. I've just been a little distracted, I think. That's pretty normal when work gets overwhelming, right? I'm sure once I get the shop sorted out, everything will go right back to normal with everyone. Do you think they understand that I'm just going through a busy patch?
Have you been making impulsive decisions lately, like acting on things without fully thinking them through?

Um, impulsive? Well, I don't think so. I really try to be careful about the choices I make, especially with the shop and everything. I mean, I always want to do the right thing and think things through. 

I guess... I don't really know what you mean by impulsive. Like, doing something crazy or dangerous? No, I definitely haven't done anything like that. I've just been working on my jewelry and trying to get my shop organized. I try to be really responsible. I haven't done anything that would make people upset with me, I promise. That's a good thing, right?
Are you having trouble completing everyday tasks, like household chores or personal care, because of your mind jumping around?

Um, everyday tasks... well, I really do try to keep on top of things. I like being clean and put together, you know? I don't want you to think I'm just letting myself go or anything. 

But, um... I guess maybe things have slipped just a little bit. Like I mentioned before about the shop... I, um, I did miss that major custom delivery. And my shop records just got so, so disorganized that I actually had to stop taking new work for right now. I just wanted to make sure I could catch up and do a good job for everyone. And, well, I guess my family has been checking on me more because... they got a little worried about how far I'd slipped from my usual routines. Like, maybe I haven't been doing my laundry as much or, you know, keeping the apartment perfectly tidy. 

But I'm really trying to get back on track. It's just hard when your brain feels so busy, you know? I'm not a lazy person, I promise. I just got a little overwhelmed. That makes sense, doesn't it?
Have you noticed any changes in how your friends or family interact with you since you started experiencing these symptoms?

Um, changes in how they interact with me? Well... I mean, I think things are mostly the same. Like I said, they've been checking in a bit more, which is really sweet of them. I'm lucky to have people who care, you know? 

I guess... I don't think they're treating me differently in a bad way. Nobody's angry or avoiding me or anything like that. They just ask how I'm doing a little more often, maybe offer to help with some things around the apartment since they know I've been so focused on the shop. I really don't want them to worry, so I always tell them I'm doing my best to get everything sorted out. I think they know I'm trying really hard. It's totally normal for families to just want to make sure you're okay when you're busy, right? I'm sure it's nothing more than that.
Have you had to turn down social invitations or work opportunities because of your difficulty focusing or completing tasks?

Um, turn things down? Well, I try really hard not to say no to people, especially when it comes to my jewelry. I love making things for people, I really do. I don't want anyone to think I'm unreliable. 

But, um... like I was saying before, I did have to pause taking on new work for a little bit. It's just because my shop records got a little messy, and I missed that one big custom delivery... which I felt terrible about! I really didn't want to let them down. So I just thought it was the most responsible thing to do, you know? Just stop taking new orders until I get everything perfectly organized again. And, well, I guess that's partly why my family has been coming by more often. They just noticed I wasn't doing my usual routines and got a little worried. But I'm fixing it, I really am. It's okay to take a step back and reorganize sometimes, isn't it? I just want to make sure I'm doing a good job for everyone.
Are you having trouble doing the things you normally enjoy because of your mind jumping around and difficulty focusing?

Um, doing things I enjoy? No, no, I wouldn't say I'm having trouble with that. I mean, working with metals and stones is what I love most, and even though I had to pause taking new orders for the shop, I still really enjoy the actual craft of it. I still love sketching out new designs and looking at different cuts, things like that. 

I really try to keep a positive attitude, you know? I wouldn't want you to think I'm just sitting around being miserable or not enjoying life. Even if my thoughts are moving a bit fast lately, it hasn't ruined the fun stuff for me. I always try to make sure I'm still appreciating the things that make me happy. That's super important for staying healthy, isn't it? So, yeah, I'm definitely still enjoying my usual things. I hope that's a good sign?
Are you feeling like these changes are affecting your overall quality of life?

Um, my overall quality of life? Well, I try really hard not to look at it as a bad thing. I mean, I have a lot to be grateful for, so I really wouldn't want to complain. 

But... I guess, like I was mentioning earlier, it has been a little tough with the shop. Missing that major custom delivery really upset me, mostly because I just hate letting people down. And having to actually stop taking new work for now because my records got so disorganized... I suppose that does affect things a bit day-to-day. And, well, I know I said my family is just being sweet, but they did get pretty worried about how far I'd slipped from my usual routines. That's the real reason they've been checking on me so much lately. 

But I really wouldn't say my whole life is falling apart or anything! I'm working really hard to get everything back to normal. It's just a temporary setback, right? Everyone gets a little overwhelmed sometimes. I'm doing the right things to fix it, aren't I? I just want to make sure I'm handling it the way I should be.
Are you feeling like these changes are interfering with your ability to maintain your relationships with friends and family?

Um, my relationships? Oh, no, I don't think so. I mean, I really try to be a good son and a good friend. I'd never want my family to feel like I'm pushing them away or anything. 

Like I was saying before, they have been coming around a lot more lately. But that's just because they're so caring, you know? They just noticed I wasn't keeping up with my usual routines and got a little worried. And, well, I guess the whole thing with the shop... missing that big custom delivery and having to stop taking new work because my records got so messy... I think that worried them a bit too. 

But it hasn't ruined our relationships at all! If anything, it's really nice of them to check on me. I just feel bad that I made them worry. I'm trying really hard to get everything back on track so they don't have to stress about me. That's the right way to handle it, isn't it? Just focusing on fixing the shop and getting back to my routines so everyone can relax? I really just want them to be proud of me.
How would you rate your level of distress or upset about these changes you're experiencing?

Um, my level of distress? Well, I really try not to let things get me down, so I wouldn't rate it as, like, a ten or anything. I don't want to sound like a complainer. 

But I guess, like I was just mentioning, the stuff with the shop does upset me a bit. Just the fact that I missed that major custom delivery, and... well, that my records got so disorganized I actually had to stop taking new work for now. That part is definitely a little stressful, mostly because I just hate letting my customers down. And then, you know, knowing my family has been checking on me more because they got so worried about how far I'd slipped from my usual routines... I feel pretty guilty about making them fret. 

So, maybe like a moderate amount of upset? But I'm really trying to stay positive and just focus on fixing it. It's totally normal to be a little stressed about work and family stuff like that, right? I just hope I'm handling the stress the right way.
Are you feeling like you're struggling to manage your daily life because of these symptoms?

Um, struggling to manage my daily life? Well, I really don't want to make it sound like I'm completely helpless or anything. I try very hard to keep things running smoothly, so I wouldn't say I'm, like, failing at life. 

But... I guess, like we've been talking about, the shop has been a bit of a challenge lately. Having to pause on taking any new work because my records got so messy... and missing that big custom delivery... I suppose that does make the day-to-day stuff a bit harder to juggle right now. And, well, I know I keep mentioning my family, but the fact that they've been checking in so much because I kind of dropped all my usual routines... I guess that means I haven't been managing things perfectly. 

But I'm really working on it! I'm trying to get the shop sorted out and get back to my normal schedule so I'm not such a burden on anyone. That's a good plan, isn't it? Just taking it one step at a time to get back on top of things? I really want to be doing this right.
Are you having to rely on others to help you with tasks that you normally handle on your own?

Um, relying on others? Oh, no, I wouldn't say I'm making anyone do my chores or anything like that. I really try to be independent and take care of my own responsibilities. I'd hate to be a burden on anyone.

I mean, I know I've brought this up a few times already, but my family *has* been checking on me a lot more lately. But it's not because I'm asking them to do things for me! It's just... well, they got worried because I slipped so far from my usual routines, like I mentioned. And with the shop... you know, missing that major custom delivery and having to stop taking new work because my records got so disorganized... I think they just want to make sure I'm okay. 

They might help out a little bit here and there, just keeping an eye on me, but I'm still trying to handle the main stuff myself. I'm really trying to get those shop records cleaned up on my own so I can start taking orders again. That's the best way to handle it, right? To just accept their support but still try to fix my own mistakes? I really don't want them to think I can't take care of myself.
Are there any daily tasks that you used to do easily but now find extremely difficult to complete?

Um, extremely difficult? Well, I wouldn't say *extremely*. I'm still getting out of bed and, you know, trying to keep things going. I really want to make sure I'm not coming across like I've just given up, because I haven't. 

But... I guess it goes back to what I was saying earlier about the shop. Um, keeping the records straight used to be second nature, but they just got so disorganized lately that I had to stop taking new work entirely. And, you know, keeping track of my orders... that used to be easy, but I ended up missing that major custom delivery. So I guess those tasks have been a lot harder than they used to be. 

And my personal routines, too, I suppose. Just the basic day-to-day stuff I used to do without thinking... I kind of slipped away from all of that, which is why my family got so worried and started checking on me more. 

But I'm really trying to push through and get back to where I was. It's okay to have a little trouble with things sometimes as long as you're trying to fix it, right? I just want to make sure I'm doing the right things to get back on track.
Have you experienced significant symptoms of inattention, such as difficulty sustaining focus or making careless mistakes, for at least six months?

Um, for six months? Oh, no, I wouldn't say that at all. I really don't want you to think I'm, like, chronically careless or that I can't focus on anything. I mean, my work requires a lot of attention to detail, working with stones and metals and all that, so I usually pride myself on being pretty focused. 

I know I've been talking a lot about how messy my records got recently and missing that delivery, but that's just been a recent thing, you know? It hasn't been going on for six months or anything like that. It's just a rough patch lately. I'm usually much better at keeping track of things, I promise. 

I just... I wouldn't want to give the impression that I'm always making mistakes. It's just been a little harder lately, but not for that long. That makes sense, right? Like, it's normal to have a few weeks where focus is a bit harder without it being a long-term problem? I just want to make sure I'm giving you the right picture.
Have you been experiencing these difficulties with focus and completing tasks for more than a few weeks?

Um, more than a few weeks? Oh, no, definitely not. I really don't want you to think this is how I always am. Like I said, I usually have a really good handle on my work and my focus. 

It was really just... well, it started right after I won this award at a jewelry show recently. I was just so excited and, um, I guess I got a little wired and out of control for a bit there. But that really intense stretch, where everything got so disorganized and I missed that delivery, it only lasted for about two weeks. 

So it hasn't been a long-term thing at all. Just a couple of weeks where things got a bit too fast for me to keep up with. I'm already trying to get everything back to normal. That's a good sign, right? That it was just a short phase and not something permanent? I really hope you can see that I'm usually very responsible.
Have you been experiencing difficulties with focus and completing tasks for at least six months?

Um, no, definitely not for six months. I know we just talked about this, and I really don't want to sound like a broken record, but I just want to be absolutely clear that this isn't a long-term problem for me. 

Like I mentioned, it was really just that two-week stretch after the jewelry show where things got a little chaotic. Usually, I'm very focused and on top of my work. I mean, you can't really do what I do if you're making careless mistakes all the time, right? 

So, no, not six months. Just that short little blip recently. I hope that makes sense? I just want to make sure I'm giving you the right information so you don't think I'm, you know, completely falling apart or anything. I'm doing my best to keep it all together.
